nodes.summary: For a real polynomial $f = \sum_k a_k x^k$ and a natural number $k$, $\tilde c_k(f) = (k+1)\,a_k^2 - k\,a_{k-1}a_{k+1}$, where $a_j = 0$ for $j$ above the degree of $f$; for $k = 0$ the second term vanishes, so $\tilde c_0(f) = a_0^2$.
nodes.title: Newton-type coefficient differences

nodes.summary: For a real polynomial $f = a_0 + a_1 x + \dots + a_n x^n$ of degree $n$, set $a_{n+1} = 0$, $\tilde c_0(f) = a_0^2$ and $\tilde c_k(f) = (k+1)\,a_k^2 - k\,a_{k-1}a_{k+1}$ for $1 \le k \le n$, and let $v(f)$ be the number of parity changes between consecutive terms of the increasing list of indices $k \le n$ with $\tilde c_k(f) > 0$. nodes.title: Parity-change bound on real zeros (conjecture)

nodes.summary: For a real polynomial $f = a_0 + a_1 x + \dots + a_n x^n$ of degree $n$ (with $n = 0$ for $f = 0$), set $a_{n+1} = 0$, $\tilde c_0(f) = a_0^2$ and $\tilde c_k(f) = (k+1)\,a_k^2 - k\,a_{k-1}a_{k+1}$ for $1 \le k \le n$. This is the list of the indices $k \in \{0, \dots, n\}$ with $\tilde c_k(f) > 0$, in increasing order.
nodes.title: Indices with positive Newton-type difference

nodes.summary: For a real polynomial $f = a_0 + a_1 x + \dots + a_n x^n$ of degree $n$ (with $n = 0$ for $f = 0$), set $a_{n+1} = 0$, $\tilde c_0(f) = a_0^2$ and $\tilde c_k(f) = (k+1)\,a_k^2 - k\,a_{k-1}a_{k+1}$ for $1 \le k \le n$. Let $k_1 < k_2 < \dots < k_m$ be the indices $k \le n$ with $\tilde c_k(f) > 0$. Then $v(f)$ is the number of $i < m$ such that $k_i$ and $k_{i+1}$ have different parities.
nodes.title: Parity changes of the positive-difference indices

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
